meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍主流短篇榜单，把握网文热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想写短篇网文却不知道什么题材能火
copy.tagline_en: Scan trending short-story rankings across major platforms to spot hot genres
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web fiction and want to know which themes are trending

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按“确认平台→采集/获取数据→分析→出报告”的流程，分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的热门短篇数据，输出情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警和选题建议等扫榜报告。
howto.when: 当你说“短篇什么火”等关键词，或输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜 时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的热门短篇
say.note: Claude 会采集知乎盐言榜单并给出扫榜报告。

say.text: 七猫短篇最近什么题材火？
say.note: Claude 会针对七猫做题材热点分析。

say.text: 对比黑岩和点众的短篇风口
say.note: Claude 会做跨平台对比分析。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude scans popular short-story data across platforms (Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong, etc.) and outputs a scan report covering emotion popularity, trending themes, risk alerts, and writing suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says what short stories are hot or similar, or inputs /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜.

say_en.text: Scan the hottest short stories on Zhihu Yanyan.
say_en.note: Claude will collect the ranking and output a scan report.

say_en.text: What short-story themes are trending on Qimao?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze theme trends for Qimao.

say_en.text: Compare short-story trends of Heiyan and Dianzhong.
say_en.note: Claude will compare the two platforms.
